message.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.

We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month commitment and have adjusted our pricing to reflect both the extended term and the recent AS-14404 index decrease. Please note that for a contract duration of 24 months, we must include an AS-14404 index clause to responsibly manage raw material fluctuations. With this index clause in place, we can accept your requested 90-day payment terms and offer a revised unit price of EUR 5.50. 

We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

Our offer is a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Beside our main offer, we can propose these alternative packages:
- a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
- Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.50 per unit.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

message.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your continued partnership with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Ourangebot is a price of €5.40 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We note your preference for the AS-14404 index clause with a 5 % deadband, which requires a price of €5.40 per unit. 

You mentioned an unchanged annual volume; please provide the exact volume figures so we can verify this. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
